meta_description: Review your personalized Up Hellas employee benefits offer — accept or decline securely from any device.
demo_gallery_lede: Pick a product to open a fictional sample offer.
page_title: Your offer is waiting for you
page_subtitle: The new era of employee benefits is here. At Up Hellas, we design solutions that make everyday work simpler and easier.
page_title_network: Your partnership proposal is waiting for you
page_subtitle_network: This isn't just an offer, it's a partnership proposal. Join the Up Hellas network of partner merchants and open your business to thousands of new customers.
modal_accept_desc: Would you like to move forward with accepting the offer?
modal_accept_confirm_text: Once you accept it, we'll get in touch within the next 24 hours.
modal_reject_desc: No worries… we all make mistakes! It would really help us to know the reason, so we can improve.
reason_not_fit: The services are not a good fit
error_select_reason: Please select a reason for rejection.
error_accept_failed: Something went wrong while accepting the offer. Please try again.
error_reject_failed: Something went wrong while submitting your rejection. Please try again.
success_subtitle: Thank you! Check your email for the next steps.
step_1: You'll receive the contract by email.
step_3_kyb: We give you portal access, where you complete KYB/eKYB.
step_3_gfe_rewards: We send you login credentials and give you access to the Management Portal.
step_3_fitpass_client: You send us the employee details, we activate their subscriptions, and they can start training.
step_3_core_merchants: Our partnership begins, and you are ready to welcome Up cardholders.
step_3_fitpass_gym: We send you the QR code, our partnership begins, and you are ready to welcome Fitpass members.
step_3_generic: We give you access to the Management Portal.
rejection_subtitle: No worries, it happens even to the best of us. If you change your mind, you know where to find us.
rejection_step_2: You can request a new offer anytime.
rejection_step_3: Want a second opinion? We're here to talk it through again
sales_contact_help_description: Reach out to your Account Manager.
destruction_timer_message: Time's running out on this offer...

offer_error.reference_hint: Share this code with your Account Manager so they can help faster.

MISSING_TOKEN.title: Request Access
MISSING_TOKEN.subtitle: This page is for viewing a personalized offer.
MISSING_TOKEN.description: Ask your Account Manager for your personal offer link.

EXPIRED_TOKEN.title: This offer has expired
EXPIRED_TOKEN.subtitle: The acceptance window for this offer has passed.
EXPIRED_TOKEN.description: Your offer link has expired, but they can send you a new one.

INVALID_LINK.title: Invalid Link
INVALID_LINK.subtitle: We couldn't open this offer.
INVALID_LINK.message: The link you followed is invalid or has expired
INVALID_LINK.description: Please contact your Account Manager for a new one.

UNSUPPORTED_OFFER_TYPE.title: Offer unavailable
UNSUPPORTED_OFFER_TYPE.subtitle: This offer couldn't be displayed.
UNSUPPORTED_OFFER_TYPE.message: The offer type is missing or not supported
UNSUPPORTED_OFFER_TYPE.description: Please contact your Account Manager for a new offer link.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.title: Something went wrong
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.subtitle: We're having trouble loading this offer right now.
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.message: Please try again in a moment
UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.description: If the problem continues, contact your Account Manager for help.

not_found_message: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved. Double-check the link or head back home.
